with days as (
    





with rawdata as (

    

    

    with p as (
        select 0 as generated_number union all select 1
    ), unioned as (

    select

    
    p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)
     + 
    
    p1.generated_number * power(2, 1)
     + 
    
    p2.generated_number * power(2, 2)
     + 
    
    p3.generated_number * power(2, 3)
     + 
    
    p4.generated_number * power(2, 4)
     + 
    
    p5.generated_number * power(2, 5)
     + 
    
    p6.generated_number * power(2, 6)
     + 
    
    p7.generated_number * power(2, 7)
     + 
    
    p8.generated_number * power(2, 8)
     + 
    
    p9.generated_number * power(2, 9)
    
    
    + 1
    as generated_number

    from

    
    p as p0
     cross join 
    
    p as p1
     cross join 
    
    p as p2
     cross join 
    
    p as p3
     cross join 
    
    p as p4
     cross join 
    
    p as p5
     cross join 
    
    p as p6
     cross join 
    
    p as p7
     cross join 
    
    p as p8
     cross join 
    
    p as p9
    
    

    )

    select *
    from unioned
    where generated_number <= 730
    order by generated_number



),

all_periods as (

    select (
        

    (cast('2025-01-01' as date) + cast(row_number() over (order by generated_number) - 1 as bigint) * interval 1 day)
    ) as date_day
    from rawdata

),

filtered as (

    select *
    from all_periods
    where date_day <= cast('2027-01-01' as date)

)

select * from filtered


)

select
    cast(date_day as date)               as date_day,
    extract(year from date_day)          as year,
    extract(month from date_day)         as month,
    cast(date_trunc('month', date_day) as date) as month_start,
    extract(isodow from date_day)        as iso_weekday
from days

with invoices as (
    select * from "sales_finance"."analytics_staging"."stg_invoices"
),

prices as (
    select * from "sales_finance"."analytics_intermediate"."int_contract_prices"

select
    i.invoice_id,
    i.customer_id,
    i.service_code,
    i.invoice_month,
    i.billed_parcels,
    i.amount,
    i.currency,
    p.price_per_parcel                                   as contract_price,
    round(i.billed_parcels * p.price_per_parcel, 2)      as expected_amount,
    round(i.amount - i.billed_parcels * p.price_per_parcel, 2) as amount_difference,
    abs(i.amount - i.billed_parcels * p.price_per_parcel) > 0.01 as is_amount_mismatch,
    i.currency <> 'EUR'                                  as is_wrong_currency,
    coalesce(p.is_invalid_price, true)                   as is_invalid_contract_price
from invoices i
left join prices p
    on  i.customer_id  = p.customer_id
    and i.service_code = p.service_code
    and i.invoice_month between p.valid_from and p.valid_to

-- revenue, cost and contribution margin per customer and month (clean records only)
with revenue as (
    select customer_id, invoice_month as month_start, sum(amount) as revenue_eur
    from "sales_finance"."analytics_marts"."fct_invoices"
    where not is_wrong_currency and not is_amount_mismatch and not is_invalid_contract_price
    group by 1, 2
),

costs as (
    select
        customer_id,
        cast(date_trunc('month', pickup_date) as date) as month_start,
        sum(parcels)  as parcels,
        sum(cost_eur) as cost_eur
    from "sales_finance"."analytics_marts"."fct_shipments"
    where is_known_customer and not is_negative_cost
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    c.customer_id,
    d.customer_name,
    d.segment,
    d.country_code,
    c.month_start,
    c.parcels,
    r.revenue_eur,
    c.cost_eur,
    r.revenue_eur - c.cost_eur                                  as contribution_margin_eur,
    round((r.revenue_eur - c.cost_eur) / nullif(r.revenue_eur, 0), 3) as contribution_margin_pct
from costs c
join "sales_finance"."analytics_marts"."dim_customer" d on c.customer_id = d.customer_id
left join revenue r on c.customer_id = r.customer_id and c.month_start = r.month_start
